obligations.title: Provide timely access to personnel, information, environments and decisions needed for the Services.
Comply with the Customer's notified site, security and conduct policies.
Implement appropriate technical and organisational security measures for personal data and bind personnel with access to confidentiality.
Assist the Customer in responding to data subject requests and regulatory enquiries.
Return or delete personal data at the Customer's election on termination or expiry.
Keep the other party's non-public information confidential and use it only for the Services, including after termination or expiry.
